understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life before resetting stamina. Walls block movement, so blocked_directions must be checked before every action. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange to blue to green to red to orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A goal activates when all three attributes match, then must be entered to complete it. Losing all lives ends the game.
